notes:
High-level: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building in-app AI features: conversational help, doc search, and dev tooling. Team initially wants Hosted API for speed-to-market; evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput as feature usage grows. Very cost-sensitive — unit economics discussion required.

Key asks / quotes from execs: "We need sub-150ms median latency for triage chat; cost per MAU critical — target < $0.03 per MAU per month for inference". CTO: "If Dedicated can cut our token costs by 40% with batching and quantization, we can justify reserved capacity."

Technical preferences: prefer small-to-medium open models (Llama-2 variants / 7b-13b) for control, but open to Redwood-verified larger models for hard summarization paths. Wants transparent fallback policy to hosted variants.

Security / compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for dev and prod access, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration mandatory. Data residency: US + EU for enterprise accounts.

Commercial: prefers POC then 12-month commit for Dedicated if POC shows 30-50% TCO improvement vs Hosted. Primary concern: burst capacity pricing and handling hot prefix workloads.

Workshop focus requested by customer:
- Intelligent batching experiments: variable batch sizes by endpoint (chat low-latency vs embeddings high-batch)
- KV/prefix caching to reduce repeated prompt tokens for frequent workflows
- Quantization profile trials (8-bit/4-bit) to validate quality and latency tradeoffs
- Unit-economics modeling: tokens-per-session, daily active users to ARR impact, break-even for Dedicated commit levels

Sales notes / tone: conversational, technical demos are resonating. AE emphasized Redwood console cost breakdowns and per-route dashboards. Customer response: interested but "need numbers" — scheduling cost-optimization workshop next week.
